answer_1.quote: The success of neural models has greatly advanced the research of dialog generation.

answer_2.quote: We first used automatic metrics to evaluate our method: 1) Distinct (Dist) ... 2) Entropy (Ent) ... 3) Low-Frequency Token Ratio (LF) ... 4) BLEU ...

answer_4.quote: Three individual annotators were employed to rank each response pair from three aspects: 1) Fluency (Flu.); 2) Coherency (Coh.); 3) Informativeness (Info.). We also asked the annotator to choose an overall preferred response (Pref.).
answer_4.guideline: Rank responses on fluency, coherency, and informativeness; choose overall preferred response.
